name: Digital Signature for eCommerce Checkout
author: Pluginorbit

sections.description:
The WooCommerce Digital Signature plugin adds a signature field directly on the WooCommerce checkout page. Customers can sign during checkout—perfect for agreements, waivers, consent forms, and other legal acknowledgments. This plugin ensures compliance and adds a layer of trust to your WooCommerce store.

Features

  • Add a signature field to the WooCommerce checkout.
  • Customize pad width, height, pen color, and background.
  • Choose signature field position on both the checkout page and order details page.
  • Save signature in PNG or JPEG format.
  • Require signature field with custom validation message.
  • Customize signature label.
  • Enable Download button on frontend.
  • Responsive and mobile-friendly signature pad.

Pro Features

  • GDPR Consent with customizable label and validation message.
  • Restrict signature to logged-in users only.
  • Customize button labels (Clear / Undo / Redo / Download).
  • Customize Button Colors: Set custom colors for all signature pad buttons.
  • Signature download button on the admin order page.
  • Include signature in WooCommerce order confirmation emails.
  • Attach signed PDF invoice to customer emails.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Digital Signature to configure
sections.faq:
Is the digital signature legally binding?

Yes. The signature is captured as an image and can be stored or attached in order confirmations and invoices, helping with legal compliance.

Can I require the signature field?

Yes, you can enable the “required” setting in the plugin’s admin panel to make it mandatory.

Does it work with mobile devices?

Yes. The signature pad is fully responsive and supports both desktop and mobile touch input.

Can I customize the signature pad style?

Absolutely. You can change pen width, pen color, background color, and canvas size in settings.
